## Filtering and Preparing HIV Data(Data clea)

```{python}
import re

# Filter for HIV indicator
hiv_filtered = hiv_data[hiv_data['Indicator'].str.contains("Estimated number of people \(all ages\) living with HIV", regex=True)].copy()
hiv_filtered['Estimate'] = hiv_filtered['Value'].str.extract(r'([\d,]+)')[0].str.replace(',', '')
hiv_filtered['Estimate'] = pd.to_numeric(hiv_filtered['Estimate'], errors='coerce')
hiv_filtered = hiv_filtered[['Location', 'SpatialDimValueCode', 'Period', 'Estimate', 'ParentLocationCode']]
hiv_filtered = hiv_filtered.rename(columns={'SpatialDimValueCode': 'Country_Code', 'Period': 'Year'})
hiv_filtered.head(10)
print(hiv_filtered.columns)


```

## Clean Poverty Data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
poverty_data = pd.read_excel("multidimensional_poverty.xlsx", skiprows=1)

# Rename columns for easier access
poverty_data = poverty_data.rename(columns={
    'Country code': 'Country_Code',
    'Reporting year': 'Reporting_Year',
    'Economy': 'Country',
    'Monetary (%)': 'Monetary_Deprivation',
    'Educational attainment (%)': 'Education_Attainment',
    'Educational enrollment (%)': 'Education_Enrollment',
    'Electricity (%)': 'Electricity',
    'Sanitation (%)': 'Sanitation',
    'Drinking water (%)': 'Drinking_Water',
    'Multidimensional poverty headcount ratio (%)': 'Poverty_Headcount'
})

# Drop rows with missing key information
poverty_data = poverty_data.dropna(subset=['Country_Code', 'Reporting_Year'])

# Replace '-' with NaN and ensure numeric types
columns_to_clean = [
    'Monetary_Deprivation', 'Education_Attainment', 'Education_Enrollment',
    'Electricity', 'Sanitation', 'Drinking_Water', 'Poverty_Headcount'
]

for col in columns_to_clean:
    poverty_data[col] = poverty_data[col].replace('-', pd.NA)
    poverty_data[col] = pd.to_numeric(poverty_data[col], errors='coerce')

# Preview cleaned poverty data
poverty_data.head()
print(poverty_data.columns)



```

## Visualization: Trend of HIV Cases in Countries Contributing to 75% of Global Burden

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

latest_year = hiv_filtered['Year'].max()
top_data = hiv_filtered[hiv_filtered['Year'] == latest_year].sort_values(by='Estimate', ascending=False)
top_data['CumulativeSum'] = top_data['Estimate'].cumsum()
total_sum = top_data['Estimate'].sum()
top_data['CumulativePercent'] = 100 * top_data['CumulativeSum'] / total_sum
top_75_countries = top_data[top_data['CumulativePercent'] <= 75]['Location'].unique()

# Filter trend data
top_trend_data = hiv_filtered[hiv_filtered['Location'].isin(top_75_countries)]

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 8))
sns.lineplot(data=top_trend_data, x='Year', y='Estimate', hue='Location', marker='o')
plt.title("Trend of HIV Cases in Countries Contributing to 75% of Global Burden")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Estimated HIV Cases")
plt.legend(loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.2, 1), fontsize='small')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Visualization: Trend of HIV Cases in Top 75% Countries Within Each WHO Region

```{python}

# Identify top 75% countries within each WHO region
region_latest = hiv_filtered[(hiv_filtered['Year'] == latest_year) & (hiv_filtered['Estimate'].notna())]

region_top = (
    region_latest.sort_values(['ParentLocationCode', 'Estimate'], ascending=[True, False])
    .groupby('ParentLocationCode')
    .apply(lambda x: x.assign(
        CumulativeSum = x['Estimate'].cumsum(),
        Total = x['Estimate'].sum(),
        CumulativePercent = 100 * x['Estimate'].cumsum() / x['Estimate'].sum()
    ))
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

region_top_75 = region_top[region_top['CumulativePercent'] <= 75]
region_countries = region_top_75['Location'].unique()

# Filter main dataset
region_trends = hiv_filtered[hiv_filtered['Location'].isin(region_countries)]

# trends by WHO region

g = sns.FacetGrid(region_trends, col='ParentLocationCode', col_wrap=3, height=4.5, sharey=False)
g.map_dataframe(sns.lineplot, x='Year', y='Estimate', hue='Location', linewidth=2, marker='o')

# Move the legend outside the plot
g.add_legend(title="Country", bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.1)

# Set labels and titles
g.set_axis_labels("Year", "Estimated HIV Cases")
g.set_titles(col_template="WHO Region: {col_name}")
g.fig.suptitle("Trend of HIV Cases in Top 75% Burden Countries by WHO Region", fontsize=14)

# Add gridlines
for ax in g.axes.flatten():
    ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Resize figure and fix overlap
g.fig.set_size_inches(16, 10)
#g.fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.90)  # <- THIS LINE FIXES THE OVERLAP

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()



```


```{python}

# Merge on matching keys
merged_data = pd.merge(
    hiv_filtered,
    poverty_data,
    left_on=['Country_Code', 'Year'],
    right_on=['Country_Code', 'Reporting_Year'],
    how='inner'
)

# Drop rows with any missing key values
merged_data = merged_data.dropna(subset=[
    'Estimate', 'Poverty_Headcount', 'Education_Attainment',
    'Education_Enrollment', 'Electricity', 'Sanitation', 'Drinking_Water'
])

# Apply log transformation to HIV estimates
import numpy as np
merged_data['log_HIV'] = np.log1p(merged_data['Estimate'])

# Preview result
merged_data.head()
